honest_framing.dialogue: n=10 short dialogues (median 490 chars). 7/10 under v2a's short-prompt safe-guard = pass-through. v2a is a news-tuned compressor; dialogue-tuned variant is Phase 2 scope.
honest_framing.rag_qa: n=10 RAG queries over SAME 4281-char system prompt. The reduction is deterministic (same compression applied); 10 queries vary. Tight CI reflects determinism, NOT 10 independent samples. The reduction number (45.6%) is the single compression-ratio measurement on this system prompt.
honest_framing.aggregate_sample_size_across_phases: R3 n=11 paired + R6 n=33 (3 models × 11) + R7 n=20 = 64 paired measurements; one compressor applied across all.
